guides.tagline: Register an OAuth app in minutes, no approval - but GitHub nudges you toward GitHub Apps instead.
Self-serve app creation and distribution with no review - until you want a Marketplace listing, which takes weeks.
Sign-in scopes are instant; sensitive scopes need verification measured in weeks; restricted scopes add a paid annual security assessment.
Sign-in and sharing are self-serve, but almost everything else sits behind partner-program approval.
